name: Hibernal-Fathom

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: An atom-forged theocracy that believes the planet is a sealed reliquary, and forbids its opening.

description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws an ancient meteor crater, patient as erosion itself.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Roads and orbital mirrors betray minds at work, engineering on a civil scale.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
The ore-body estimates keep being revised upward, which keeps the gun-runner schedules full.
